🤔 What is HMPV?
A respiratory virus causing cough, fever, and even pneumonia in high-risk groups like kids & elderly. No specific treatment yet, but prevention is key! 🧼 Wash hands, cover coughs, and stay safe. Learn more: https://t.co/
